q22. `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15` (called from `CreateMemo` handler at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157`, which fans out via `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` → `webhook.PostAsync`); delivery package: `internal/webhook` (async queue in `PostAsync`/`init()` drains into `Post`, which performs the actual `http.Client.Do` POST — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120-180`); signing mechanism: Standard Webhooks-style HMAC-SHA256 — an HMAC over `msgID + "." + timestamp + "." + body` keyed by the per-webhook `SigningSecret` (base64-decoded if in `whsec_<base64>` form), sent as `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature: v1,<base64 hmac>` headers (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:97-150`).
